description: Get a published popup's script URL and ready-to-paste embed snippets for plain HTML, React/Next.js, WordPress, and Shopify. The snippet contains no API key - the trigger, targeting, and audience rules stay server-side. For a Webflow-connected company, returns embed.disabled plus the native Webflow settings path and no custom code.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

popupId.description: Saved popup ID returned by list_popups or create_popup.

name: get_popup_embed

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_popup_embed` MCP tool.

embed.description: Script URL plus HTML, React, WordPress, and Shopify snippets.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

popup.description: The saved popup record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
